name: acne-unused-test-v1-vs-v3-1
status: fixed before any acne model output on these photos, before preflight and before labelling
question: On photos never used before, how many false points does frozen v3 remove relative to frozen v1, how many distinct targets does it lose, and for which scope is that reliable?
frozen: docs/acne-unused-test-freeze-20261016.json (v1 b6fa6c05..., v3 94d18abb..., Step0 18e94a95..., feature / filter / chain / landmark code hashes). No training, fine-tuning, calibration or threshold search; confidence .30, NMS .30, old box filter, features, standardisers and thresholds unchanged. No point filter, merging, ensemble or new model. The photo command default stays v1.

scope.pool: the sealed Skin care v5 test archive (plan-v3 TEST_CROSS_SOURCE, 903 rows); this task authorises opening its verified-unused part for this comparison only
scope.selection: scripts/skin-research/unused_test_select.py -> audit-results/acne-unused-test/scope.json (copied to docs/acne-unused-test-scope-20261016.json): 643 rows excluded with reasons (289 inferred before by Step0 on 2026-10-15; group links to other archives or excluded rows; dHash/flip <= 10 to any of 33k rows of the other 14 local archives or to excluded rows; shared Roboflow family); ORB/RANSAC crop/collage check against 2,362 photo files of our research records and the 289 excluded test rows
scope.extraExclusion: row 0034b55b2f58... had 24 ORB/RANSAC inliers to an excluded (previously inferred) test row while every other kept row had 0; the written rule was >= 25, it is excluded as a suspected copy (decided before any acne output)
scope.kept: 259 photos (all 640 x 640) in evaluation groups that merge near-duplicates inside the kept set (same plan group, same Roboflow family or dHash <= 10)
scope.onePerGroup: within each evaluation group only ONE photo is evaluated: the product-eligible photo with the lowest sha256 (decided by this rule before any output); near-duplicate copies would otherwise count the same face several times. All-photo counts are reported separately.
scope.notClaimed: person identity is unknown (no person-independence claim); Step0's original pre-training data is unknown, so overlap with it cannot be ruled out; publisher labels are not truth

eligibility: unchanged product rules: local MediaPipe (product face_landmarker.task) -> frontend replay (quality, pose, snapshot; eyewear not replayed = UNKNOWN) -> product photo_input crop -> tile budget. Only status 'replay-pass (eyewear UNKNOWN)' photos are evaluated; every other status is listed separately and never counted as a success. A photo is never dropped because the model produced no candidate.

labels.rule: same as acne-point-relabel-protocol-1 (layer 1): TARGET = centre of a visible acne-like single lesion; MOLE, SCAR_PIGMENT, OTHER separate; UNCERTAIN where no reliable decision is possible; coverage flags (collage / closeup_not_full_face -> empty mask, targets still count); per-tile not_reviewable and exclusion rectangles; mask = face oval - eyes/brows (dilated 0.03 fw) - lips, within reviewable tiles, minus exclusions
labels.how: full-face tile sheets (original pixels + source-pixel grid only; no source boxes, no model points, no predictions exist yet); decisions recorded per photo
labels.freeze: labels and masks hashed and committed before inference
labels.level: AI engineering review, not expert verification, not fully blind (the reviewer knows the study), no clinical truth claim
labels.role: test only: these labels are never used for training or calibration

inference: once per evaluated photo from the raw file: local MediaPipe + product preparation -> fixed Step0 candidates -> old box filter -> frozen features; the SAME candidates and features go to v1 and v3 (their own verifier files are the only difference). Step0 alone is computed from the same records. Outputs cached; labels enter no inference, crop, scale or filter decision.

scoring.rule: same as DEV: source-pixel points (box centres), r = 0.03 x face width (landmarks 234-454), deterministic one-to-one matching (max cardinality then min distance), classes matched / duplicate / nearOutOfScopeTarget / onOther / onUncertain / false (inside reviewed mask) / unreviewedInOval / nonSkin / unreviewedPhoto
scoring.mainScope: all TARGET points inside the reviewed mask of every evaluated photo (product-filtered targets are NOT removed from the denominator)
scoring.diagnostic: separate table restricted to targets inside the product analysis scope (current product masks; exposed-cheek scope for side captures)
scoring.report: Step0 / v1 / v3: photos, targets, distinct targets found and rate, false points total / mean / median per photo, duplicates, uncertain, non-skin; v3 vs v1 gained / lost target ids; per-photo paired differences with photo-cluster bootstrap 95% CIs (10,000 resamples, seed 20261016); subgroups FRONT vs side (LEFT/RIGHT capture) and face-width tertiles (TRAIN edges 588 / 899 px) with their denominators; time and memory on the same hardware
scoring.notAllowed: no pooling with DEV results, no carried-over acceptance numbers, no new acceptance threshold; a CI containing 0 is not evidence of equivalence

rights: licence and source rights are not resolved by this test (publisher-declared licences only; no individual consent records)
